integrity: All universal claims have an analytic argument; finite checker outputs corroborate but do not independently certify infinite statements. No independent mathematical audit is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The optimization is over cube hyperplane sections perpendicular to one fixed body diagonal, not over all orientations; the dimension-three unrestricted optimum and the Irwin-Hall density are previously known. The stated expansions are asymptotic and historical priority remains provisional.
title: A unique diagonal cube-pyramid optimizer with two sharp asymptotic corrections
